steps.name: A Different Air from Yesterday
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Glinda] in 「Dorothy Village」.

steps.name: An Unwelcome Visitor in Town
steps.objective: Find out what happened in front of [Glinda] in 「Dorothy Village」, then turn in the quest to [Runo] in 「Dorothy Village」.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Put away that horrified look. And take your hand off your sword.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: The leader of the Agasura, here...? What do you want?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I have business... No, a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jeril...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: The Agasura I've heard so much about?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Shh, Mandarava. We're the only ones who know she's here. Keep quiet and act normally so Binah and Ruso don't notice.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Here. Some cotton.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Understood, Glinda. You're the best.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: What an amusing spirit. Anyway, it's been a while, %s. I knew you'd left Glaston, but I didn't expect to find you here.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: How can I persuade our witch to help me? Tell me if you need anything. I could fetch it right away. Or would you prefer some useful information?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Get to the point. Why are you here, and what information are you offering?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: My friend is sick. Ordinary medicine doesn't work on an Agasura. I thought something you made might help...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could she mean Kazno...?)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: How about information on Lux's fragments and the like, those parasites on this world?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lux...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Very well. I'll make your medicine.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Make it according to this.
(Jeril hands Glinda a sheet of paper that appears to contain a medicine recipe.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I happen to have all the ingredients. But I've never seen a recipe like this. I have no idea what symptoms this medicine might cause.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Whatever happens is fine. I won't blame you. Just make it, and I'll never come back.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, stay with Jeril for a moment. This won't take long.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Thank you, witch. I'm counting on you.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: %s, you look tired. Rest after I leave. For now, listen to what I have to say while she makes the medicine.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: What? Don't want to?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not that...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Then what would you like to hear?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Make a choice.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You know Lux's ultimate objective, don't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To steal the gift of foresight? No. To become a god...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Exactly. You know your stuff. He's sending incarnations of himself to various places to carry out his will. The human calling himself Aaron is one of them.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: He splits his shadow into pieces and sends them to other worlds to seize control. Until he gets what he wants.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: If anyone in the Demon Realm can stand against Lux now, it's probably Barbatos...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Strangely, Lux and Barbatos haven't lifted a finger against each other. As if they have some unspoken agreement.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Anyway, you know Daphne is involved with those two, don't you? And the Goddess of the Black Moon is watching over it all. How very interesting...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: The medicine I asked Glinda for is for Kazno. He said he has to hold on a little longer, so I came all this way. I don't know how long medicine can keep him going.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: He keeps losing Hilda. When does he think he'll ever summon Ouroboros and catch it?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Honestly, it's all such a bother. He never needed to catch Ouroboros in the first place...

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It all happened because he got involved with that Der girl. Because of his pointless stubbornness.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Don't you agree?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: If Kazno had simply lived as an Agasura should, you wouldn't be who you are now, either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You don't understand. Yes, that's for the best.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I don't go to Glaston often, but when I visited this time, a lot had changed.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Perhaps it's because Aaron has left Glaston.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: One piece of the vast shadow that rules the Demon Realm disappeared, and light found its way into the Empire. That's all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me exactly what you mean.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Better you experience it yourself than hear it from me. If that's what has to happen anyway...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Everything she says is so vague. I don't feel any better.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Frustrating, isn't it? But what can you do? Everything in this world has become your concern. You can't avoid it just because you want to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what are you trying to say?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Now isn't the time. I'll visit you another day. I can't carelessly talk about things Kazno and the goddess both hate.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Though that depends on your choice, too... Ah, witch, finished? I like how quick you are.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I could only make about ten doses.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: That's enough. It should keep him going for a while.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: When he can hardly hold on, have him take it thirty minutes after a meal. Now leave the village as promised. And don't return.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Harsh, but I suppose I have no choice. Farewell, witch. Adventurer %s, I'll see you later.
(Jeril leaps into the air and disappears beyond the lake outside the village.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Will this be all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...It will.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I don't know what that Agasura told you, but I can see it on your face. You need to leave Dorothy Village, don't you?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: You must still be tired from your travels...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: You always say you're fine. I suppose that's just your nature. All right. Get a good rest today and leave tomorrow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Glinda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If Aaron has disappeared, where did he go? I'll have to go to Glaston and find out...)

steps.name: The Way Back
steps.objective: Say goodbye to everyone in front of [Runo] in 「Dorothy Village」, then turn in the quest to [Moran] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Can't you two stay a little longer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd love to stay, but I have things to do.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Then at least Letty could...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I'm sorry, Binah. I can't stay in Dorothy Village forever if I'm going to fulfill my duties as a knight.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Sniff.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Glaston isn't far away. I'll visit often. I can leave fresh cotton by the entrance to Oscar Road, right?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Leticia thinks I'm a fish flapping around on a baited hook.
(Leticia throws a little ball of cotton toward the lake. Mandarava promptly flies after it and catches it.)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Mandarava's flapping. Meow.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: You've already learned how to handle Mandarava.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. Thank you for looking after me while I was here.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It's only my duty as the village's owner.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's kind of you to say that, Glinda.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Thank you for everything, Glinda.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Leticia, do come visit now and then. Visiting is fine, but don't bring anyone with you. You understand?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes! We wouldn't want you killing innocent people, so I'll be sure to come alone.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: That's true, but something about how you put it...

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: Boss, I don't think Letty means any harm.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Ahahaha, sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, where's Elliot? I haven't seen him.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. We haven't seen Elliot since you went to Lindos, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 루노
lines.text: He does disappear sometimes, but he's been gone quite a while this time.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: %s, if you see Elliot, tell him to use the thing I gave him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll tell him if I see him. We'd better get going, then.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Goodbye! See you all next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, everyone. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Safe travels!
(Binah waves until Leticia and %s are out of sight.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I hope nothing happens...

steps.name: As If Nothing Had Happened
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Moran] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」, then go to [Silvia] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」.
2. After talking to [Silvia], turn in the quest to [Leticia] in 「Street North of the Plaza」.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, %s! We're almost back in Glaston already.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, shh. Be quiet for a moment.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Okay. I'll be quiet.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Letty, what are you doing there?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Waaaaah! Y-you startled me! Mr. Moran?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Moran? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Oh, %s? I'm always all right. But why are you coming out of there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Mr. Moran, why are you acting like nothing happened? The knights and soldiers... Mmph, mmph, mmph!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, come here a moment.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Mmph! Mmph! I can't answer with your hand over my mouth!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry. Moran doesn't seem to know anything...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Mr. Moran always looks like that, so it's hard to tell what he knows. But the way he's talking, he really does seem clueless.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, let's go to where Silvia usually is. She'll be slacking off around this time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Mr. Moran, we were on patrol.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: ...This isn't your area.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Commander Argent gave me permission to check Oscar Road, too. I've got a witness right here. You know %s, right?

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: Oh, is that so? All right. I thought you'd gotten into trouble again.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Come on, do you think all I do is cause trouble? See you later, Mr. Moran.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Moran, we'll be going now.

lines.speaker: 모란
lines.text: You must be busy. See you next time.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s! Hurry! Let's go find Silvia slacking off.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Why do people have to keep working? I wish we only worked four days a week. No, three.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Ah, I'll just rest a little longer before going back.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow! That's Silvia for you. Slacking off, just as expected.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: You idiot, I told you that's not what I'm doing! Oh, Letty? %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Silvia, how have you been?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: When did you get here? Are you all right? I was so worried after sending you off like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lot happened, but I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Silvia, you know... Mr. Moran and everyone in the square are acting completely normal.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The knights and soldiers passing through the square seem to be on ordinary patrol, too.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I thought that was strange, too. Nobody remembers what happened. It's as though someone erased only that memory.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As though their memories were erased...

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Strangely, I remember it. If everyone forgot, I should have forgotten that moment, too...

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Anyway, Argent told me to keep quiet about it. He said talking about it would violate an imperial order.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aside from that, is everyone all right?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Yes. I've checked several times. Everyone's going about their lives as usual. I think the only ones who remember are you two, a few members of the Scar of the Red Moon knights, Her Majesty, my brother, and me.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Oh, right, Letty. My brother asked me to pass on a message. Act normally when you return to Glaston.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: So I should patrol as usual?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: %s, Her Majesty had a message for you. She said to stay in Glaston and rest for a few days when you arrived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was that all she said?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: That's all I was told. Oh, what time is... Aah! My senior's going to come looking for me!

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: I'd better get back to the office. %s, see you later. Letty, I'll call you later.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Okay. Stop slacking off and get back in there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Silvia.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: What will you do, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I should do as Her Majesty says. I'll be at the LaChouette Inn. Come find me there if anything happens.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Okay! Let's have a meal together later. My treat! Hehe. Thanks for everything, %s.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I'm going home, then. Goodbye!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bye, Letty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I really need to speak to Her Majesty and hear what happened... When will I get to see her?)

steps.name: The Next Destination
steps.objective: Talk to [Leticia] in 「Street North of the Plaza」, then use the portal to 「Glaston Administrative District 1」 to follow [Lena]. Once everything is over, turn in the quest to [Lif] in 「Lifthrasir」.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, you're here again today.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, how was your day?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I patrolled from the square to the administrative district. Nothing happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No messages came while I was away, did they?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: No, nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. How long am I supposed to wait...?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The commander must be really busy, too. I haven't seen him for days.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Oh, that person...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Do you know that person, %s? She saw you and is coming this way...
It's been a while, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, who are you?
My clothes change a little and you don't recognize me? I'm a little hurt.
Still don't recognize me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Lena!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while. This is...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: You're Leticia, the free knight serving under Commander Argent, correct?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That's right. But who are you?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: My name is Lena Hyren. I'm here to speak with %s.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hyren, Hyren?! Oh! I've heard of you. You're a famous noble family! I heard you run the Empire's finest brewery, too.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I'm glad you've heard of us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena, what brings you here...? Oh, is it all right for Letty to hear this?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Her Majesty knows about Knight Leticia. It's nothing particularly sensitive. She may listen.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Her Majesty does? Really?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I believe Commander Argent told her.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow! Wow! I'm going to tell Mom when I get off work!

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Keep your secret mission to yourself. You may only tell her that Her Majesty knows of you.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Of course. I've never told my family a single thing about my missions.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Good. Now, %s...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Her Majesty is waiting. Follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Lena.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Okay! See you later.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I know you've removed the danger hanging over Glaston and dealt with the Magic Bureau, which towered in the Empire's shadows.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: We were looking into it as well on Her Majesty's orders. We call ourselves Silver Claw agents, yet it seems we left everything to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. Oh, do you remember that man?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Aaron, I believe. I do have a distinct feeling that there was someone by that name.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The residents don't remember him, but I and a few other agents close to Her Majesty seem to remember him vaguely.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The man who tormented the imperial family and Her Majesty so relentlessly...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something I'd like to ask...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wondered how much you know.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I have a general understanding. That witches, demons, and Aaron are involved...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: And that these events threaten the goddess's safety.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The Silver Claw is dealing with anything that could threaten the Empire. Our aims may differ somewhat from yours.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I hope you understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's quiet around here, though. As if there's no one around...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: We've closed some government offices and restricted access. Not because Her Majesty is visiting, but because we're purifying the demonic power left over from the previous incident.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Wait here a moment. I'll bring Her Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.
(Kaina approaches %s with quick little steps and clasps both of their hands.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You've been through so much...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not at all.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Your Majesty, I will withdraw with Lady Lena while you speak with %s.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: No, you may stay. Lena, will you stay as well?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, what do you think of Glaston as it is now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a city going peacefully about its daily life, completely unaware of the terrible things that nearly happened...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: That is how Glaston should always have been. My predecessors and I failed it by not realizing what Aaron was doing.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thanks to you, %s, we stopped his crimes against the Empire. But traces of him still remain.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Aaron, an incarnation of a ruler of the Demon Realm, merely vanished from Glaston... and his existence disappeared from the people's memories.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: As though someone erased the city's memories...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, you can guess who did that, can't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: That is why I asked you here today.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you have a vision...?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: That witch had rabbit ears, didn't she?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: A woman with rabbit ears was walking along a coast filled with pink salt crystals. She was looking toward a village near the cliffs.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: A place like that would be...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I believe it is Salar Coast in Alfheim, and Nidaros, the village of the Dokkalfr.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: As expected, Lena. You recognized it from the description alone. And...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I saw Aaron inside an enormous airship. It was somehow different from the airships currently operated by the Silvaria Empire.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Though I cannot say exactly how it differed...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, was Barbatos in your vision?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: No. I did not see him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. I'd better go there right away.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Wait, %s. Are you leaving immediately?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After leaving Glaston, I learned that witch's objective. I also learned she won't stop until she achieves it. I'd like to see for myself.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Can you tell me what that objective is?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes... Well...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Lena, would you give us a moment?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly explain Daphne's objective to Kaina.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I see. So that happened after Aaron and the witch fell out...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, if you go to Nidaros, assess the situation before you act. And if you need help, speak with Lena.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Lena.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: What is your current assignment?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: We have been tracking Aaron and the demons connected to him. I was focusing on Glaston...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Then would it be possible to move your area of operations to Nidaros?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Yes, of course.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, Lena will show you the way to Nidaros. Go together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Don't feel burdened, %s. You'll be doing your job, and I'll be doing mine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you put it that way... Thank you, Your Majesty. Thank you, Lena.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I wish I could be of more help...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You have done more than enough, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, may I ask one thing?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Please do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you happen to see me meeting them, or what happens afterward?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: No, I did not see that far. I would have told you if I had. Oh, is it that late already...?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, I'm sorry, but I must be going.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Lena, %s. Have a safe journey.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, Lena, until next time. This way, Your Majesty.
(Argent escorts Kaina away into the administrative district.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena, shall we go, too? How do we get to Nidaros?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: There's a road in Lifthrasir leading to the northeastern coast. Let's go and pay our respects to Lif first.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Oh, you don't know...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: To travel from Ljosalfr territory to Dokkalfr territory, you need permission from the village leader. The same applies the other way around.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I have something about my assignment to pass on to another agent...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll wait in Lifthrasir. I'll go ahead and speak to the director.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: All right. See you in Lifthrasir.
(Lena runs from the administrative district toward the road overlooking the imperial palace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. Nidaros... I'd better get ready and go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I hope nothing happens there...

steps.name: The Crimson Coast
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Lif] in 「Lifthrasir」. Be sure to use the portal to enter 「Salar Coast」.
2. Meet [Askren] and talk to him, then defeat [Rabbit Dronimal] and [Cera Alba No. 1] in 「Salar Coast」. Turn in the quest to [Askren] in 「Salar Coast」.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Under twinkling moonlight, in the crystal forest ♬ We wake to drops of clear and lovely dew ♬

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Elves of the morning, let us all sing ♬ The light of Lifthrasir is drawing near ♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Director.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Under twinkling moon... Oh, %s? It's been a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director, that song you were singing... I've never heard it before. It sounds like something students would sing at a school on a hill.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does the next part happen to go, 'Blessed by the spirit of Crystal Moon Forest~'?

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Huh? Huh? Wow, how did you know? You said you'd never heard it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know, either. I was just guessing. I didn't expect you to be so surprised...

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: It's a children's song passed down for generations among Lifthrasir's children.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Anyway, are you here to see me? Or...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Neither. I'll have to decline.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: How do you know what I'm going to say? Turning everything down like that... How heartless.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I have too much to do.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Tell me if you ever change your mind. I suppose one of those things brought you here today?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Something came up, and I need to go to Nidaros. I heard I need your permission to travel from Ljosalfr territory to Dokkalfr territory.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Then you have it. If you're going to Nidaros, give my regards to Embla, who runs the Ash Tree tavern.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: And tell her I'm sorry I couldn't be there for what happened with Stellan.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Thanks to you, I can send her my regards. Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Come to think of it, outsiders have needed permission from village chiefs to travel between regions of Alfheim for a very long time.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: When relations between the Ljosalfr and Dokkalfr were poor, travel was difficult. Only those with permission could cross.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Even elves had trouble, so humans unfamiliar with the situation often got themselves into difficulties.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: These days, for convenience, we just have visitors sign the official guestbook instead of asking the chief's permission.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Now, %s. Will you sign here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director, this isn't a guestbook. It looks very much like a contract involving Lifthrasir.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Oops, you caught me. Just kidding! Here, this is the real guestbook.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Oh, what a shame. I was going to get you to settle here for good...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can hear you, Director. Anyway, thank you.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Hehe, you're welcome. Goodness, look at the time. I'm busy today, so I'm afraid I can't talk any longer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's all right, Director.

lines.speaker: 리프
lines.text: Good luck. Bye-bye!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Director.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm. When will Lena get here? Oh, there she is.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Sorry I'm late. Did you speak to Director Lif?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. She said we only need to sign the guestbook. Have you signed it?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I signed after listening to the history of Alfheim with the director, enjoying some Lifthrasir Green Ale, and making a donation to the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I consider it strengthening relations between the Empire and Alfheim. I'd rather you didn't look at it negatively.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, she changed the subject.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Come on, %s. Nidaros is this way. Follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Lena.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (All right, let's go...)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: This is where Salar Coast begins. On your first visit, it's easy to lose track of time admiring the mysterious scenery.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow... It's beautiful. I've traveled all over Freios, but this is incredible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Those salt crystals glittering everywhere in the sunlight are so beautiful.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: They may look like ore or rocks, but they're all salt crystals.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Enjoy the view, but we should hurry a little. Night comes quickly in Nidaros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right. We'd better hurry.
Huh? Oh! Oooooh!
Wow, %s! It's been a long time!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Who are you? I don't think we've met.
That hurts! We've never met? You really don't remember?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I really don't...
If you'd seen me before, you couldn't possibly say you don't know me... How could you forget this face?
Very well. I'll give you a hint. The Twilight Cathedral...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure.
You beat up the priests who'd been consumed by an evil power there, didn't you? I was one of them. Probably one of the priests somewhere on the second floor!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... I still don't remember.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I fought so many people then that I can't remember who was who.
Hahaha, that's all right. You brought me back to my senses. And you beat me without leaving a scratch on this handsome face! Truly, the goddess's grace!
Allow me to introduce myself properly.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I am Askren, a priest of the Immortal Priesthood of the Hodmis Order. I recently became its youngest fifth-rank priest. Haha.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: My work is confidential, so I can't go into detail, but I accomplished quite a great deal.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Perhaps that's why the village elders are putting up a banner reading 'Nidaros's Pride, Fifth-Rank Priest Askren' and organizing a party for me. Hahahaha.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: What an unusual priest...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I hear that quite often, Lady Lena Hyren.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: You know my name, too. Not that it's strange for someone from the Immortal Priesthood... You weren't waiting for us, were you?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Haha, this really is a coincidence. If you're that suspicious, ask the Order. I'm simply a priest enjoying a vacation to celebrate my promotion.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Or ask Director Lif in Lifthrasir. I went to greet her and tell her I was on vacation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something feels off...)

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Nidaros is my hometown. It's such a shame that my priestly duties keep me from returning except on vacation.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: All right. I'll take your word for it since you're a priest.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Thank you. The goddess will be pleased.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I've been to Nidaros through Salar Coast before, but the route seems different every time. It's confusing.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I was just heading to the village myself. Would you care to take a shortcut with me?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: A shortcut... Sounds good.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Father Askren, could you show us the way?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Of course. It would be an honor.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Oh, but the shortcut has quite a few monsters. We'll have to clear them out as we go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Leave that to me. There shouldn't be monsters on a road the villagers use.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Oh, how admirable! Shall we deal with them together?

steps.name: Nidaros, the Seaside Village
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Askren] in 「Salar Coast」, then defeat [Valiant Magic Knight].
2. Travel to 「Nidaros」, talk to [Lena], then turn in the quest to [Embla].

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I think that takes care of most of the monsters. You're even better than I'd expected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing special.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: What exactly were you expecting, Father?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Your fighting skills are remarkable. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: (He doesn't inspire much confidence...)

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The goddess seems to have brought us together today. May I buy you an Ash Wave when we reach the village?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It isn't alcohol-free, is it?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Haha, no.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Visiting Nidaros without drinking an Ash Wave? That's like saying a Priring didn't eat its snack.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a strange comparison.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: There's an alcohol-free version, too, so don't worry. Embla, the proprietor, will make you a delicious one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the person Director Lif asked me to give her regards to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Father Askren, how much farther is the village? This is a bit long for a shortcut...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Head southwest from here and you'll reach Nidaros. Over there is one of Salar Coast's spectacular sights, a great hole in the rocks.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: You can watch the seawater flow in and out. The elves of Nidaros gaze at it and pray for everyone's well-being.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Fishermen heading out to sea also use it to judge the waves. That's why the area is called the Sea of Wisdom.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: There are other stories about that place, but I can't quite remember them. Ask the villagers sometime.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Father. Oh, but there's something over there...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think there's something down here.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Something below this cliff? There's nothing but sand and sea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was I imagining it...?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Maybe the unfamiliar scenery gave you a strange feeling.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Father?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Oh, nothing. Seeing the sea for the first time in a while has given me a lot to think about.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Nidaros is this way. Let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He definitely looked startled by something just now...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I shouldn't worry about that now. I need to reach the village and find out what Daphne is planning.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Thank you, Father. That's our lodging taken care of.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Father.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Think nothing of it. Such distinguished guests have come to my hometown. Providing this much is only natural.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I don't know what brought you to Nidaros... but I hope you can finish your business comfortably and return safely.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Father Askren. That smile looks awfully suspicious.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I'm always smiling. Haha. No one can resist this smi...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena? Wait, what are you...?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Suddenly pointing a gun at my head... That startled me.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: If you're going to play games, be less obvious, Father. Did you think we'd ignore your constant attempts to sound us out?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I think there's been a misunderstanding...
(Click.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Father Askren, what happens next depends on your answer.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Sigh. You're rather impatient. I'm not supposed to tell you yet, but I'd rather not die... Take a look at this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An imperial identification card and documents from the Order?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The Order instructed me to help %s if the need arose. You could call it a support role.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: On whose orders?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The Pope's and Demigod Lydia's. Look here...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: That's the Pope's official seal, and Demigod Lydia's signature... I've seen that handwriting before. Confirmed. I apologize for the misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Haha, I can see why you misunderstood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much help are you prepared to give?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Well, I don't know what will happen, but I'll do everything I can while you're here.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I'm quite a useful priest, you know.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: %s, I really don't like this priest. Shall I throw him into the sea?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Calm down.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Hahaha, you do like your jokes...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: You're serious.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I'll be going now. If anything happens, let me know.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: You can easily find me near the part of Salar Coast where we rested before entering the village, or on the east side of town.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: And if you need information, try Embla.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Father.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Thanks, Father Askren.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: You're welcome. Haha. I'll take my leave, then.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: %s, what do you think of that priest? Can we trust him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure yet...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: He seems to have some idea why we're here... Well, we have no choice. We'd better start asking around.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's split up.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I don't know how long it will take, but how about we meet at this time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That works. I'll meet you in front of the clock tower then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's look around the village and gather information... I need to find Daphne's trail quickly.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I hurried, but the fish still hasn't come to take the bait. Sigh. %s... I needed to finish this before you arrived...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: ...I'm beginning to regret wishing you quite so much luck.

steps.name: Beneath the Ash Tree
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Embla] in 「Nidaros」, then complete both side quests (Crystallized Salt) and (One of Three).
2. Review the situation in front of the clock tower, then turn in the quest to [Embla] in 「Nidaros」.

lines.text: Should I close up early today? There are no customers, and I'm sick of looking at Askren's face... Oof.
(An elven woman comes out of the building and stretches. Her eyes meet the approaching adventurer's.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello.
Welcome, customer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, me?
Who else is here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you Embla?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Just call me Embla. How do you know me, though? You don't look local...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Director Lif in Lifthrasir asked me to give you her regards.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Grandma Lif did? What did she say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That she's sorry she couldn't be there for what happened with Stellan.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Grandma Lif is so busy, and I wasn't in the village then, either. It couldn't be helped. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you don't mind my asking, what happened?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Before I answer, there's something I want to know. Who are you?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: If Grandma Lif sent you, you must be someone special.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Wow, that's you? You're someone amazing! Even I've heard how you saved the world over and over.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing special.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: A hero who's humble, too. What brings you to our village? I doubt you're just here to pass on a greeting...

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Do you need information?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: No need to look so surprised. If someone as remarkable as you comes all the way to remote Nidaros, you must have a reason.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: You came to the right place. It's small, but this is a tavern, so all kinds of information come through. My father left some behind, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. May I ask a few things, then?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I'm acting village chief right now, so I can't just tell a visitor anything they ask. That said, interested in a part-time job?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: It's nothing difficult. Think of it as a deal. There are two jobs, and you can do them in either order. But you have to finish both. What do you say?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Once they're done, I'll tell you what I know. You get three questions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll do it.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: For the first job, go to Carmen, who's practicing her dancing, and mention me. You'll soon find out what to do.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: For the second, I'd like you to help Lars with his worries. I don't know what's wrong, but he's looked troubled lately... It seems to be something us adults can't help with.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll go now.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Thanks. I'll be waiting.
(A bench near the clock tower.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's rest a little before going to Embla... Whew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The ruins Father Askren mentioned... That's what I sensed near the coast...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I looked carefully as I passed the shore, but I didn't see anything like that. Where could they be...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could they be...? No, nothing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (They don't seem to be in the sky like Atlas Garden, either...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something painted on the clock tower's glass.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: An angel?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena, when did you get here?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Just now.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: About that picture on the glass... Usually angels in pictures like that spread their arms as though embracing someone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This one's different. With its fists clenched, it looks ready for a fight.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you found anything out, Lena?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It seems someone I know has come to Nidaros. That's all I've found.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: %s, sorry. I'm going to head back and rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's wrong with Lena? She seems a little strange...)

steps.name: Information in Hand
steps.objective: Talk to [Embla] in 「Nidaros」, then turn in the quest to [Gregory] in 「Salar Coast」.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Thank you. For helping Carmen and Lars. Everyone looks much happier.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad, Embla. Is there anything else you need?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: No, you've done plenty. Honestly, I didn't expect you to take on all of it.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I wanted to know what sort of person you were, so I asked too much of you. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: It's quiet right now, so let me give you an Ash Wave by way of apology. It's a refreshing drink, no alcohol. Nothing to worry about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! That's really refreshing. It feels like it clears me right out.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I'm glad you like it. Shall we begin? Ask whatever you'd like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I ask Embla?)

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: He was my father. He passed away recently.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I didn't know...

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: You have nothing to apologize for. Shall I tell you about him?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: He was an unusual man. He looked after the village as chief by day and ran the tavern at night.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: He wanted his only daughter to inherit the tavern, but I hated the idea and left the village. So I barely saw him.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: We were the sort of father and daughter who'd say things the other hated and fight whenever we met.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I was resting in Esnil when a pigeon arrived carrying a letter. Askren sent it. Father had died, and I needed to come home...

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: You don't know Askren, do you? He's...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I do. Father Askren showed me the way here.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: He did?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Nobody knows what tomorrow will bring. Father was so healthy... I never imagined he'd be gone so suddenly.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I'm glad Askren was there for his final moments... Apparently Father had collapsed near the coastal cliffs.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I have no idea what made him collapse...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The cliffs...? Where I felt something strange?)

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: He was ill for a few days before he died, and left these strange words as his will. Look.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: [I, Stellan, grant Askren, who is like a son to me, all services of the Ash Tree free of charge. Should I be unable to provide them, my daughter Embla will continue to do so...]

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I'm grateful to Askren, but he had Father's will notarized by the Order and every other authority he could find. So I have to follow it.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Sigh... I suppose it was just like Father. He was always such a prankster... He and Askren really hit it off.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He sounds like a cheerful man.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Thank you for saying that. Though... can this really count as information?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth did Embla's father see...? I'll have to find out later.)

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: You mean the clock tower in the center?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I saw it while passing by. Its glass decoration is beautiful, and the bell that rings on the hour has such a gentle tone.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: That? It's about a hundred years old, I think. The Silvaria Empire built it as part of an exchange.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Clock towers were popular in elven villages back then. I suppose the people of Nidaros wanted a landmark in the village center and asked for one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was something painted on the glass?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Oh, that? An angel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An angel?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Our villagers believe there's an angel somewhere in the sea.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: They say that when something bad happened to the village, mysterious singing would come from the sea. Hearing it calmed their hearts and helped them endure unbearable hardships.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: That story has been passed down, and we still pray toward the sea. Simply wishing for happiness.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: It doesn't matter whether an angel really exists. Nothing offers greater comfort than that warm belief.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a lovely story.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A village protected by an angel... Could it be a battle angel like Michaela or Raphaella?)

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: If you want to hear more about the angel, go see Grandpa Gregory.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I don't know whether he was just telling stories to entertain the children, but he said he saw the angel himself long ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An old man who met an angel? Hmm. I'll keep that in mind...)

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Nidaros is remote, so outsiders don't come here often.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Most of the Ash Tree's customers are villagers whose faces I know.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: That's why people from elsewhere, like you, stand out right away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: You're looking for someone, aren't you? Describe them. I might remember someone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A stern-looking man in his mid-to-late forties with a scar on his face. He's a noble of the Silvaria Empire.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I haven't seen anyone like that. I did see a young nobleman with strikingly sharp eyes. He looked incredibly cold.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think that's who I'm looking for.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: I'll tell you if I see someone like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A young nobleman with sharp eyes... I'll remember that.)

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: That's all I can tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Embla.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: It's nothing. I look forward to seeing you around.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Embla... You're not asking anything else?

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: You do what you need to do. We'll do what we need to do. All right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Grandpa Gregory! You're here.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Here, take this.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: That's an enormous tuna today. Thank you for always bringing us something.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Hoho. This is about all I can do for you.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Anything you'd like to eat?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Not today. You there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Who else is here besides you and Embla? I'd like a word. Are you free? I saw something strange.
(Gregory approaches %s and whispers.)

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Would you happen to be looking for a woman with rabbit ears?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Judging by your surprise, that beastkin must be the one. Then follow me.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Embla, I'll be going. Something's come up for your guest, too.

lines.speaker: 엠블라
lines.text: Goodbye, Grandpa. You take care, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Embla.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sir, let's hurry.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Never mind 'sir.' Call me Mr. Gregory. This way.

steps.name: The Angels' Sea
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Gregory] in 「Salar Coast」, then enter 「Sea of Wisdom」.
2. Defeat [Gabriella] in 「Sea of Wisdom」, then pass through the reward room and watch all the events. Go outside and turn in the quest to [Gregory] in 「Salar Coast」.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Here. This is where the woman with rabbit ears appeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Sea of Wisdom...

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: You know it already?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Father Askren told me.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: I was going to tell you about the angel when we met, but the timing's awkward.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: This would have been the perfect place for it, if that woman hadn't appeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did she go?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: She saw me fishing here and said, 'Kid, you didn't see me,' then jumped into the sea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right here?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: I wondered if my eyes were deceiving me and rushed to pull her out, but she'd already gone too deep to reach.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: So I looked for you as soon as I got back to the village.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: How long has it been since someone called me a kid? Anyway, is that woman a witch?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: I'm no expert, but I can sense a little magic. She seemed different from an ordinary mage...

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: When I met the angel long ago, she said I was lucky I hadn't encountered a witch or a demon.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: That was fifty years ago... but I remember it like yesterday.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait. Doesn't that mean meeting a witch or a demon would be disastrous?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: ...Does it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to hurry.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Wait. What are you planning?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm going in right away.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: That's reckless. This hole connects to the sea. Jump in carelessly and you could be swept right out of the Void Sea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should I do?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Take this. The angel gave it to me when she saved me long ago. It let me breathe underwater on the way up... Though it doesn't seem to work now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you sure you can give me something like that?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: The angel said to give it to someone who could help her, should such a person appear. I think that time has come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Mr. Gregory.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Then prepare yourself properly before you go in.
Splash.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: What an impatient youngster. Already all the way down there. Shall I wait here and fish, then...?
Splash.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: W-what? Someone else jumped in?!
(Small waves rise, and the seawater slowly begins to turn black.)

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: What is this?
(Through the hazy view, part of a temple-like ruin comes into sight.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Somehow it looks a bit like Coral City, though it's different. To think there's a place to breathe like this underwater...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Are these the ruins Father Askren mentioned?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah... Hah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The angel's feather saved me, but where do I go now? I've made it inside...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's that? A huge shadow, all of a sudden...)
Crash!
Oh my, you dodged well for an intruder. What a shame. I'll compliment you once, but not twice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Th-the floor caved in. Huh?
(Looking up after recovering, I see a woman with blonde hair and blue eyes standing with her fist tightly clenched.)
Tell me, which do you like?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?
Sparkling salt crystals, an ugly bonito, or crumbled ruins. Go on, choose.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?
Which would you like to become? Shall I recommend one? I think salt crystals would suit you. They shatter so nicely.
(As she speaks, enormous wings spread from her waist, and she flies up to %s in an instant.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A battle angel? Urgh!
(A straight punch, an uppercut, then a spinning kick send the adventurer crashing to the ground.)
Crash!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...
Get up. We're not finished.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Angel, please listen... I'm...
Quiet. Do you know how much trouble villains who asked me to listen have caused me? Whew...
Very well. Since I'm an angel, I'll give you a special chance. Will you take a few more hits and die, or surrender and flee?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of angel acts like this?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is this what Grandpa Gregory meant?)
Oh my, you seem to have preconceived notions about angels. Then try living a better life in your next incarnation. Now... Huh?
(At that moment, someone grabs the angel's wrist.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hello, Gabriella.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Who are you? How do you know my name? Let go of my hand!

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: ...Ugh. What are you? I-I can't move.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Why do you have Hecate's power...? No, are you a demon?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I'm not a demon. I do have a little of Hecate's power, but I'm different from her.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Let go and then talk!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: How amusing, an angel lying so shamelessly. You'll swing at me the moment I let go.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Very well. I'll let you go, but I'll be taking the Star's Tear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Star's Tear?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: ...Just try taking it!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hehe. I can't wait to see what you'll do to me, Gabriella. I'll go on ahead. Farewell.
(With those words, Daphne vanishes before my eyes.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Ah, this is maddening. She clearly knew where it was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gabriella, please listen...
(Before the adventurer can explain properly, Gabriella beats her wings and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Gabriella! Wait!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...We didn't even get to talk, and now there are more misunderstandings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. No choice. I'll have to search this whole place if that's what it takes to find Gabriella and explain...

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Daphne, where are you?
Bang!

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Daphne, come out while I'm asking nicely. It's all right. I don't intend to hurt you.
Bang!

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Let's talk this through. We both know Hecate, after all.
Bang!
(Despite her words, Gabriella kicks and punches apart everything in front of her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. How am I supposed to explain? She doesn't seem the type to listen...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You don't need to be wary of me here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did you come from?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Still so suspicious. Set that aside for a moment. We can think about what comes next later.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: There's something I need you to do here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why should I do anything for you...?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I came down here to seal Aaron away.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's true...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Aaron is after the Star's Tear. I intend to use it as bait to seal him away. The odds aren't high, of course. I'll have to trust in luck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What if you fail?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I'll pay the price.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Explain properly. Now.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Buy me a little time.
(With those words, Daphne turns toward Gabriella and shouts.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Gabriella!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The Star's Tear you're guarding is right here.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: You can't have that!
(Gabriella shouts and flies toward Daphne and the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I'm counting on you, %s. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne? Daphne! What? Wh-where did she go?!

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Daphne!

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Hand over the Star's Tear you're holding! Now!
(Gabriella reaches out her hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gabriella, Daphne has disappeared. Let me explain.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Daphne, you've had your last warning.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is what she meant by buying time? Sigh...

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I am Gabriella, battle angel. By the command of the great god, I shall annihilate you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whew. Let's hold out as long as I can...)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Daphne!
(Gabriella unleashes one powerful attack after another at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her attacks seem even stronger than before.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hah... Hah... How much longer can I hold out...?)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Give up and accept your fate. To think you've endured an angel's judgment this long...
(At that moment, a brilliant flash fills the entire space, and it shakes as though struck by an earthquake.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Wh-what is happening?!

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: ...You! Why were you pretending to be Daphne?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Oh, this is...
(Gabriella hurriedly picks up something that has fallen at %s's feet.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is Michaela's feather here...?
(Gabriella holds the feather to her chest and closes her eyes. Only then does the shaking stop.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Mika, Rafi, Ur...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gabriella?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: %s, I'm sorry. Let me introduce myself properly. I'm Gab, the battle angel Gabriella.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you read the other angels' memories?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I learned about Iris, the new God of the Astral Realm, too.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I'm sorry. I had no idea. Gab misunderstood and nearly hurt you.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Gab didn't mean to...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gabriella, speak normally. This isn't how you usually are.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Whew! May I? Thinking of my sisters made me try talking like this for the first time in ages, but it's exhausting.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Oh, right. The Star's Tear! There's no time for this.
(At that moment, someone taps Gabriella on the shoulder from behind with a staff.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Daphne?!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Be quiet for a moment.
(Just as Gabriella is about to swing her fist, she loses consciousness and falls to the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: %s, keep quiet so you don't wake our angel. Make a fuss, and there's no telling what I might do.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Unfortunately, I couldn't seal Aaron. My luck was terrible this time. It can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: It simply means you and I have more to do...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Long ago, in an age whose date no one knows... A being wanted to meet the god who had cared for it. So it kept building something in secret.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: At last, a great winged ship capable of reaching the realm of the gods was complete.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: But there was one small problem. It had no fuel.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Then one day, the time came when gods vanished and fled beyond the world. Those who had once been gods seized the Wings to save themselves.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The method they found to move the Wings, which had sat without fuel...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Was the Star's Tear. A crystal containing the souls of countless lives.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait... Does that mean the gods...?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: ...Shall we leave that old story there?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Aaron will soon board the Wings and head deep into the realm of the gods. He'll destroy every place that stands in his way.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The moment it collides there, the great wall will crumble, and everything within Etoile will be hurled outside.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Then the power of the Demon Realm will enter and spread through the world. A rather excessive tantrum for someone who failed to obtain a witch's power, wouldn't you say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are these Wings headed...?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You know the place. Atlas Garden.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: %s, the Star's Tear needs to warm up a little before the Wings can operate. Even so, you'd better hurry.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hesitate, and everyone will disappear.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Good luck, then, %s.
(No sooner has she finished speaking than Daphne vanishes without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you awake, Gabriella?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I'm all right. But the Star's Tear...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll stop the Wings from taking off. Rest here, Gabriella.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: The Wings of Icarus... So you know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So their name is Icarus...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly explain what Daphne told me and what I know about Aaron.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Long ago, there was someone whose name I can no longer remember. They stopped the Wings from operating, and as they vanished, I fled with the Tear.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: The Twisted Ones pursued me for the Star's Tear. Then a great explosion erupted somewhere, and I fell into the sea.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: The impact could have destroyed me, but when I opened my eyes, I could breathe and move as though nothing had happened.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: The Star's Tear, a soulstone a Twisted One made by gathering living souls, protected an angel who had failed to protect life.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I could stay in this new space, the Sea of Wisdom... But whether a curse or a blessing, I could never return to land.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Much like the other angels.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: ...So from then on, I made protecting the Star's Tear my mission, and swore never to let it fall into enemy hands.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: To think I'd lose it like this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gabriella, don't worry. Trust me.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: All I can do now is trust you and wait, %s.
(Gabriella approaches %s and gently kisses their cheek.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Don't be surprised. This is my greeting as Gabriella. A sign that I trust you, %s...

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: You can reach the coast by going up, but it takes time. Since we're in a hurry, I'll help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How?
(Gabriella grabs the adventurer with one hand and lifts them up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: G-Gabriella?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: You're lighter than I expected. Close your eyes and think, 'I'm a bird. I've become a bird.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? A bird?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I'm going to send you flying out of the sea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gabriella, w-wait!

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Haaaaah!
(With a great shout, Gabriella hurls the adventurer upward with all her strength. A whirlpool rises with them.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: ...Hurry, %s. My wings may be humble, but they will open the way.

steps.name: Adventurer for Hire?
steps.objective: Talk to [Gregory] in 「Salar Coast」, then turn in the quest to [Askren] in 「Salar Coast」.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: ...?! A flying fish? No...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaaah!
(Gregory spots the adventurer shooting into the air with the waves, then quickly jumps up and catches them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaah?
Crash!
(Gregory lands on the sand with a great thud and sets the adventurer down.)

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Whew. Haven't jumped like that in a while. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I-I'm alive. Th-thank you, Mr. Gregory.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: The angel threw you, didn't she?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: She threw me just like that when I met her. Nobody was there to catch me, so I landed headfirst in the sand.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Anyway, did everything go well down there? I didn't see the woman with rabbit ears come back out...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: %s! %s! There you are!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Father Askren?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Grandpa Gregory, something's come up. May I borrow %s?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Father, what is it?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: ...The ruins I mentioned seem to be moving. Very slightly and slowly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The ruins? Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: %s, let's hurry. Lady Lena is waiting.

steps.name: Ancient Wings
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Askren] in 「Salar Coast」, then enter 「Wings of Icarus」.
2. Defeat [Grendel] in 「Wings of Icarus」 and obtain a <Dried Star's Tear>. Pass through the reward room, and once all the events are over, go outside and turn in the quest to [Askren] in 「Salar Coast」.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Can you feel it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait... Not quite...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The world is still full of unbelievable things. To think all that happened in such a short time...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: %s, there's something I need to tell you... No. Later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Lena. But Father, I still can't sense what you described.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Let me help. May I have your hand? If I use a little divine power...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Can you feel it now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, what's that?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Pardon?
(As Askren looks ahead at %s's words, an enormous shadow falls over Salar Coast.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: That's...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could those be the Wings of Icarus...?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: %s, what did you just say? The Wings of Icarus...?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The winged ship a Twisted One rode toward the sun during the Twilight. The Wings of Icarus... It was supposed to have been destroyed and crashed...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know about that?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Well, the Order's secret records... Oops. Well, I suppose I can tell you, %s.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: ...And me?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Lady Lena, you learned this in the course of your mission. I'd appreciate your discretion.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: All right, Father.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Anyway, I take it you learned about the Wings in the Sea of Wisdom, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Father, do you know how to reach them? Was there anything about that in the Order's secret records?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: There was. I happened to see something even the Pope had kept secret. Quite by chance, of course.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: "When the mage Xerenis arrived at Salar Coast, he discovered the Wings. The Wings guided him, and in the place where they vanished, he saw the past and the future..."

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I can't say exactly what it means... %s, what's that feather? It's caught on your clothes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, is it Gabriella's? It smells like her... Huh? Where's it flying?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I'll catch it. Oh... That's...
(Askren and %s look where Gabriella's feather has landed. Directly in front of it stands a strangely shaped structure that was invisible moments ago.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An airship? Were the Wings this airship all along?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I've never seen an airship this enormous. And to think it appeared right in front of us. Ugh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Father, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: An invisible wall is blocking the approach.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Maybe only %s can approach? Yes, I can't get through, either.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I can see a way onto the airship... As though it's waiting for you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is it waiting for me, or...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena, please keep an eye on things here. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Will you be all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be fine. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: %s, let me offer a blessing, just in case.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: My prayers work so well that people who know me line up to ask for them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. Even at a time like this, Father...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Father, what is it?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I can feel the ruins' movement speeding up, ever so slightly!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better hurry. Lena, Father. I'll be back.
(With grim resolve, the adventurer runs toward the Wings of Icarus. The moment they board, the airship vanishes without a trace, as though it had been waiting.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: ...It vanished...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: We should evacuate the people of Nidaros, just in case.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: There's no need to worry. The Wings are in a different realm. Even if something dangerous happens, it will happen only within that realm.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Father, what do you mean?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Try trusting us as much as you trust %s.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: All right. I will. But if that trust is misplaced, you and the Order will be held responsible...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I understand. Now, about that young nobleman... Or should I not bring him up?
(The moment the adventurer steps toward the enormous airship, the scene before them changes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This looks like some kind of storeroom...
"Attention... please."

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "Greetings. Ferdia, sole crew member and helmsman, at your service."

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "For a safe journey, all passengers are requested to listen carefully to this announcement."
Crackle.

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "This vessel is the Wings of Icarus, built with Asgardian technology that crossed time to reach Etoile, and renewed with the spirit of the Silvaria Empire.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Asgard?!)

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "This vessel is currently en route to Atlas Garden."

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "Estimated travel time is approximately X hours. Until arrival, passengers must observe the following rules."

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "1. Passengers shall not interfere with the operation of the Wings of Icarus."

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "2. Passengers shall receive no amenities aboard the Wings of Icarus."

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "3. Passengers shall do nothing until the voyage of the Wings of Icarus is complete."

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's rather one-sided. What if I refuse?

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "If you cause a disturbance, your survival cannot be guaranteed."

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that was the plan from the start.
Crackle.

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "Ferdia does not plan. Ferdia assesses the optimal outcome based on learned knowledge and present circumstances, then acts."

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "...Captain Aaron? What would you like to say...?"

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaron?

lines.speaker: 아론의 목소리
lines.text: You came here knowing everything. No point hiding it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaron, where are you?

lines.speaker: 아론의 목소리
lines.text: You want to meet me? Very well. If you wish to see me, reach me alive.

lines.speaker: 아론의 목소리
lines.text: I wonder... Can you reach me before the Wings of Icarus arrive at Atlas Garden...?

lines.speaker: 아론의 목소리
lines.text: Ferdia.

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "...Yes, Master Aaron."

lines.speaker: 아론의 목소리
lines.text: Permission granted.

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "Threat targets designated. Interception mode activated."

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "With the master's authorization, designated passengers %s and Daphne will be intercepted."
(At Ferdia's words, enemies hidden in the shadows slowly reveal themselves.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Fine, Aaron. If that's how you want it, I'll stand in your way to the very end.
(Aaron stares blankly at the wreckage of the crashed Wings.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: The Wings of Icarus crashed... This can't be...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: And we didn't even leave Salar Coast... We were clearly flying toward Atlas Garden...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: ...The reverse side?

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I couldn't possibly have failed to detect the reverse side. I am Lux, future ruler of Etoile...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Lux's...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I am Lux's... I am Lux's...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Found you at last!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaron, you said it yourself. If I wanted to see you, I should reach you alive.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I am Lux's...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: %s... How did you stop and destroy the Wings? This is no device a mere human can tamper with!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to know how it happened myself...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I waited hundreds of years to set the Wings in motion, only for them to be destroyed so pointlessly...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I defeated Ferdia and every enemy that attacked me, and the ship crashed. But now we're on the reverse side again...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: That alone couldn't have caused this... You don't have the intelligence to stop the Wings!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you trying to say?

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: How dare you... How dare you...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: You... You've ruined everything...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't care about your problems... What was that? Ruined everything?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Looks like there's no other way.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Graaaaaaah!
(As the adventurer tightens their grip on their weapon, Aaron lets out a monstrous scream. The ground splits, and black shadows surge from the cracks.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I can simply make another plan. I no longer wish to be tied to my original, anyway.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I didn't want to go this far. This is the sort of thing that utterly graceless Lux does...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: %s, I'm going to devour you...
(The wall of shadows blocking the adventurer flows toward Aaron and clings to him.)

lines.speaker: 아론
