lines.text: I'll devour you, then consume the feeble goddess connected to your mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That form...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: The primordial darkness flowing at the bottom of the abyss, which Lux used to conquer the Demon Realm...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Grendel, who devours and defiles all!

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Aaron in human form is no more. I am no longer even an incarnation of Lux...
(Grendel raises a hand to his forehead. The darkness entwined around his body spreads as though swallowing the surroundings.)

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: I will face you as Grendel alone. I shall grant you an abyssal darkness you will never live to regret...

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Die!
(Once again, the sharp blades of darkness rippling around Grendel fly toward %s. Yet each of his attacks crumbles beneath %s's counterattack.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've faced plenty of wicked darkness like this before...

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Silence! Die, %s!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Grendel or whatever you call yourself, wicked darkness always meets the same end!
(A gap opens between the blades of darkness, and %s's attack pierces Grendel's core.)

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Graaaaaah!
(A monstrous scream fills the reverse side of Salar Coast. The shadows wrapped around Grendel flare like flames and scatter.)

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Graaah... O-once more...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Disappear!

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Heh. I won't disappear just because you tell me to. This abyssal darkness will cling to you and torment you to the end!
(%s's attack passes through Grendel, but this time he scatters and reforms.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At this rate, it'll never end. What should I do? Wait...)
(Through a tear in Grendel's darkness, a pair of twitching rabbit ears appears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne, this isn't the time to interfere!

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Stay out of this, witch!
(The sharp blades of darkness Grendel unleashes fly toward Daphne, but disperse like helpless mist before her staff.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: %s, your power has torn much of Grendel's darkness apart. Leave the rest to me.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You know it, too, don't you? You have no way to deal with his abyssal darkness.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: There's no need to force yourself to touch that evil. Why not leave it to my already stained hands?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I'll take that as permission...
(Daphne smiles and slowly steps forward.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The ever-composed Aaron, revealing his true form like this. That can't have been easy.

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Do you think you can stop me just because you've taken other witches' powers?!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: What bold words. I should commend you, foolish man... Oh, you're no longer a man, or anything else.

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: I'll take this chance to deal with you, too... U-ugh? Wh-what?!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Aaron... No, Grendel.
(At Daphne's words, all of Grendel's movements stop. Even the stains of the abyss clinging to him freeze, trapped in time.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: If you hadn't broken your promise, I wouldn't have gone this far.
(Daphne reaches out with her staff and taps Grendel's head and shoulders. The darkness supporting him slowly begins to run off.)

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Grrrr... Graaaaaaah!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Suffer. Feel the pain. Scream and crumble, until you can never rise again.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: This is the price for touching my beloved child. I believe I warned you... to leave her alone.

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Graaaaaah! Graaaaaaah!

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: To think you'd use the dregs of abyssal darkness that even Lux sealed away.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: All the better. I'll make sure you never awaken again, even in the abyss.

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: S-stop... Stop! I-I...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You want me to stop? Shall we end it, then?
(Daphne taps what used to be Grendel's head and shoulders again. Darkness drips from him onto the ground.)

lines.speaker: 그렌델
lines.text: Gaaaaaaaah...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Don't run. Let's end this just as you wished. This is the witch's power you wanted so badly!
(Daphne spots something moving in the darkness pooled on the ground. She strikes it with the tip of her staff and pins it down.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: %s, finish it.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Now!
(%s's blow shatters whatever Daphne was holding down. The darkness lingering around them slowly disperses like mist.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Well done, %s. It's a good thing I didn't steal the finishing blow like Barbatos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you knew everything.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Some things I learn whether I want to or not. Especially when they concern you.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I don't like bugs, so I left it to you. You don't mind, do you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A bug? That was a bug?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Let's call the true substance that made up Aaron a bug. At some point, the incarnation Lux created developed a mind of its own and became greedy.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Enough to defy even its original's wishes...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: In any case, the bug that grew by devouring so many souls is gone.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I originally considered sealing it away, but this works, too. We disposed of it before Lux could make his move.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you going to do now?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Who knows? Hehe.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Oh, take this. It's a little broken, but I'm sure our angel will understand.
(Daphne holds out a cracked gem that has lost its light to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something I want to ask. About Medea.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Go ahead. I suppose I can tell you about that child.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What has everything you've done been for?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: It was all to protect our people. In time, protecting Medea became a way to protect myself and everyone.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: So that there would never be another Medea created for that purpose...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: But things didn't all go as I wished.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I originally intended to awaken her as a witch of Eastland stronger than a god. Instead, she was chosen by a god and became a Transcendent.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: But it doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: After all, everything I've done is for beings like her and me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you really think this is for your child, Medea?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: %s, that is not for you to judge. It's between me and the world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't get through to her...)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Now I'll give you the answer you truly want.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The night isn't over yet. Everything rests upon the goddess Hecate's will.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The goddess's wrath imposed witches' fates upon those who had nothing to do with it. But the ending will be different.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Deicide...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I am going to kill a god, as Barbatos did. Though it will be a little different from when he, a god himself, killed another god and fell.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: At first, I only meant to use him briefly. Now we've become part of each other's plans.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: If possible, I'd like him to know true despair... Hehe.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Now, %s. As a living being, I will go to the god who shaped my life. Do not interfere. For the sake of all those who died as witches...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you serious?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: ...Did I not seem more serious than anyone? Hehe. I'll have to show a little more resolve.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: One great enemy is gone, but you still have others to fight. Let me offer you a choice.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Will you fight those who seek to kill gods and die, or do nothing and live?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: If you choose the latter, I can help. Making you an ordinary resident of Etoile who remembers nothing would be simple...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I refuse. That wouldn't be me.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Very well. I'll look forward to our next meeting. Though I can't promise how it will end.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I can no longer help you. Let me wish you luck one last time.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: If you can survive until then, of course...
(Daphne gives a small smile and waves. In that instant, she vanishes without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Wait, Daphne! I have more questions! Where is Pandora...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...She's gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's the right choice? Sigh. I don't know... Let's get out of here first...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do I get out?
Crackle.
Crackle. Crackle.

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "Route guidance error. Recalculating route. Please state your destination."

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is Ferdia's hologram...?

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "Ferdia is a navigation system provided for our passengers. State your destination, and I will guide you along the fastest route."

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I destroyed it and made sure it had stopped moving... The Wings of Icarus crashed and shattered. How is it working again?)
Crackle.

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "If no destination is entered, a route to the safest location will be calculated automatically."

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "The route from the reverse side of Salar Coast to the ordinary side lies ten steps from your current position, toward the sea."

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ten steps?

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "Automatic mode is now active. Passengers will be transported directly to the designated location."

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. First you said to walk, and now you're transporting me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... I'm suddenly so sleepy...

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "Navigation system Ferdia shutting down. Operation of the Wings of Icarus is now concluded."

lines.speaker: 페르디아의 목소리
lines.text: "It was a pleasure to see you again, Master..."

steps.name: Where the Wings Once Were
steps.objective: Talk to [Askren] in 「Salar Coast」, then go to [Gregory]. When all conversations are over, turn in the quest to [Gregory].

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: %s! %s! Wake up!

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: N-not breathing...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Hey, Father! You're the one who needs to get a grip! Look, they're breathing perfectly well.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: T-today we return our beloved %s to the goddess's embrace and p-pray for eternal rest.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: O light of e-eternal rest, shine upon %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...? Father?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Aaaaaah! B-back to life! H-holy! God has answered my prayers!

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Oh, you mad priest! Stop sending living people to heaven!
(Click.)

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Oh, was I doing that?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Hahahahaha! I'm glad you returned safely. I've come back to my senses, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But... how did I get here?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: You don't remember?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I remember clearly.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: What happened? Is it all over now? Did this make you lose consciousness?
(Askren hands %s a star-shaped gem.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: %s, tell us what happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...
(Askren and Lena listen in surprise to the account of what happened aboard the Wings of Icarus.)

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: So that's what happened.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Is everything involving the Empire over now? Ah...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I'm sorry, %s. As a Silver Claw agent serving Her Majesty, I couldn't help thinking of that first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The Empire owes you another great debt, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not at all...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Father, do you know about the reverse side?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I know it exists. But I don't really know how it appears or how to reach it.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Still, I'm glad we could arrange our own way to bring you to the reverse side of Salar Coast, %s.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Father, when you said 'us,' did you mean...?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: The elven village chiefs helped.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Long ago, ancient elven heroes fought evil demons while striving to keep the villagers safe.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: In doing so, they happened upon a space called the reverse side and learned that fighting there would not affect the villagers.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: If a once-famous demon vanished without a trace, it most likely fell on the reverse side.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Since then, the chiefs of each elven village have secretly passed down the method of finding it to their successors.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then how did you find the reverse side of Salar Coast?

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I'll tell you...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Stellan sensed something ominous first and took action...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Through me, he contacted other villages and arranged for the ruins to move to the reverse side.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: ...In the process, Stellan, who was only an ordinary elf, exhausted nearly all his magic and life force. And he passed away.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I wanted to save him somehow, but at the boundary between life and death, which even gods cannot easily cross, there was nothing I could do.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I could only pray and pray that he would rest peacefully. All he worried about was the village and his daughter...

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: It's difficult now, but someday I intend to tell Embla everything...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: That must be hard for you, too, Father.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Haha, I'm all right. Aside from Lady Lena pointing a gun at my head, of course.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: ...Sigh.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: %s, what will you do now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, I need to return this to the angel.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Are you planning another plunge into the sea?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I've done it once, so it should be fine, right? What about you, Lena?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I'll return to Glaston and report to Her Majesty. But not just yet.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I plan to stay in Nidaros for a few days and watch the situation, just in case. I have things to do, too...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I'm sure Her Majesty will allow me enough leisure to enjoy an Ash Wave while I'm here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, so that's what this is about. Let's return to Glaston together, then. I think I need some rest, too.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: I'll make sure you both get a 'proper' rest in Nidaros until you leave.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Father, that word 'proper' worries me.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Then I'll change it to 'reasonable.' Haha.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: ...Father, be reasonable.

lines.speaker: 아스크렌
lines.text: Lady Lena, since you brought it up... Would you like to hear how I plan to offer 'reasonable' assistance?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, time to escape.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll see you both in the village later. I'm going to see the angel.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Gregory, it's been a long time. Seeing you brings it all back so clearly. Did you defeat that demon?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: It was beyond my abilities, so I borrowed someone else's help...

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I should have sent it flying properly.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Not at all. You were a great help. But how did you come up here? I thought you couldn't...

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I can finally feel the air outside again. Though I still can't cross this boundary.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Thank you for worrying, Gregory. The prayers of Nidaros's people have kept me going. It's all thanks to you.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: I meant, is it all right for you to reveal yourself like this...?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Ordinary people can't see me, so it's fine. And I'll only appear when people I care about come by.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Oh, %s. Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Gabriella?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: You're here. Hmm, you have something to discuss with the angel. I'll give you a moment.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Gregory, my name is Gabriella. Next time, call my name here.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: What happened then felt so dreamlike that I never even asked your name. Thank you, Gabriella.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: I'll leave you to talk.
(Gregory gives Gabriella a quiet bow and steps back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gabriella, how did you get outside?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I think the crack in the Star's Tear removed something that was binding me.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: It feels a little strange, but I'm choosing to see it positively. I'm delighted to have more room to move after hundreds of years.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: I'd like to see how my sisters are doing, but that will have to wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happens to the Star's Tear now?

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: There are no longer any ruins in this world for it to power, but I must keep guarding it.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Something holding so many living souls could still be misused elsewhere.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: My mission isn't over. Until I disappear, I will keep protecting the Star's Tear in the Sea of Wisdom.
(As she speaks, the Star's Tear in Gabriella's hand turns into dozens of tiny droplets and evaporates.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Don't be surprised. It's simply returned to a safe place. If Iris ever asks for it, I'll give it to her at once.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I hope that day comes soon.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: What will you do now, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me? I'll rest a little, then head back. I'll pass through Glaston and go see Iris. We need to discuss what to do next...

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: My sisters seem to have heard Iris's message as soon as they met you, %s... But she hasn't said anything yet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh? Really? Wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris... Iris... Iris, are you listening?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did this incident affect the great wall? She's quiet.)

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: She'll speak when the time is right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gabriella, I'll head back now. I'll visit and bring news of the other angels.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Thank you, %s. I'd like to throw you to your destination to make the journey easier...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. I'd rather not land headfirst in the sand.

lines.speaker: 가브리엘라
lines.text: Hehe, what a shame. Then may I offer an angel's greeting instead?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That would be fine.
(Gabriella approaches %s and gently kisses their cheek. Then she yields to an incoming wave and slowly disappears into the sea.)

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: The angel's left, so I suppose you're finished talking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: To think I'd live to see a day like this... I'm curious what happened, but I'll keep my questions to myself.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: In any case, it's a relief that nothing bad happened...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh? Does he know something?)

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Ah, right. I meant to tell you this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Whenever things aren't going your way and you feel stuck, come see me. I may not be much help, but I can do something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's kind of you to offer, Mr. Gregory.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: It's nothing...

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Come on, let's head back. We're being watched... Ah, a slip of the tongue.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Don't mind me. Just a slip of the tongue.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shall we go, then? Mr. Gregory, let me carry that fish for you.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Are you sure you can lift it? If you're not careful, it could crush you to death.
Thud.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Just as I thought.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaah! Mr. Gregory! H-help! Why is this so heavy?
(Atop the cliffs of Salar Coast, someone watching the scene quietly toys with a silver coin.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The rabbit witch has tied up that troublesome Lux. Has that brought the moment closer?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hehe. Now to drag down the goddess clinging so precariously to her perch...
